title: Docs 387 no git while agents write
description: docs 387 no git while agents write
acceptance_criteria: The workflow skill's checkpoint reference, in the bundle and in an installed copy, and `docs/cli.md` each say not to run `git pull`, `git merge`, `git rebase`, `git checkout` or `git stash` in a worktree while another agent works there, why, and that a lone agent may run one between its own commands.

answers.constraints: cli lessons apply: human gates are plain text in tasks.md; the delta is frozen at approval; a changed skill file needs its released digest in KNOWN_PREVIOUS so an older install updates.
